# retrieve_several_zones_for_PCR { #wass2s.retrieve_several_zones_for_PCR }

```python
retrieve_several_zones_for_PCR(
    dir_to_data,
    indices_dict,
    variables_list,
    year_start,
    year_end,
    season,
    clim_year_start=None,
    clim_year_end=None,
    model=False,
    month_of_initialization=None,
    lead_time=None,
    year_forecast=None,
)
```

Retrieve data for multiple zones for Principal Component Regression (PCR).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                    | Type   | Description                                                                                           | Default    |
|-------------------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| dir_to_data             | str    | Directory path where data is stored.                                                                  | _required_ |
| indices_dict            | dict   | Dictionary mapping index names to coordinates (label, lon_min, lon_max, lat_min, lat_max).            | _required_ |
| variables_list          | str    | Variable string in the format 'center.variable'.                                                      | _required_ |
| year_start              | int    | Start year of the data.                                                                               | _required_ |
| year_end                | int    | End year of the data.                                                                                 | _required_ |
| season                  | list   | List of month numbers defining the season.                                                            | _required_ |
| clim_year_start         | int    | Start year for climatology period.                                                                    | `None`     |
| clim_year_end           | int    | End year for climatology period.                                                                      | `None`     |
| model                   | bool   | If True, load model data (hindcast and forecast); otherwise, load reanalysis data (default is False). | `False`    |
| month_of_initialization | int    | Month of model initialization.                                                                        | `None`     |
| lead_time               | list   | List of lead times in months.                                                                         | `None`     |
| year_forecast           | int    | Forecast year.                                                                                        | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | list   | List of xarray.DataArray objects, each representing a standardized region. |
